privacy.title: Privacy Policy
content: At Inspect Practice ("we," "our," or "us"), we take your privacy seriously. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you visit our website and use our web application for International Code Council (ICC) building inspector exam preparation.

**Information We Collect:** We collect personal information you provide directly, such as your name, email address, and payment information when you create an account or subscribe to our services. We also automatically collect certain information when you use our platform, including device information, IP address, browser type, and usage data such as exam attempts, scores, and study patterns.

**How We Use Your Information:** We use your information to provide, maintain, and improve our ICC exam preparation services; to process transactions and manage your subscription; to send you technical notices, updates, and support messages; to monitor and analyze usage trends; and to personalize your learning experience.

**Data Sharing and Disclosure:** We do not sell your personal information. We may share your data with trusted third-party service providers who assist us in operating our platform (such as payment processors and cloud hosting providers), as required by law, or to protect our rights and the safety of our users.

**Data Security:** We implement industry-standard security measures including encryption in transit (TLS 1.3) and at rest, secure authentication, and regular security audits to protect your personal information. However, no method of transmission over the Internet is 100% secure.

**Your Rights:** Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have the right to access, correct, delete, or port your personal data. You can manage your account settings or contact us at privacy@inspectpractice.com to exercise these rights.

**Retention:** We retain your personal information for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide you services, and for a reasonable period thereafter for legitimate business purposes or as required by law.

**Cookies:** We use essential cookies for authentication and security, analytics cookies to understand platform usage, and functional cookies to remember your preferences. You can control cookie settings through your browser.
